recipes.name: Sourdough Broccoli Pizza inspired by Inside Out
ingredients: 1 tbsp (+ more as needed) olive oil
whole head of garlic, peeled and separated
1 cup olive oil (enough to cover the garlic)
instructions: For the Dough

In a food processor, add the starter, flour, sugar, and yeast. Process until all ingredients are thoroughly combined. - 227 grams (100% hydration) sourdough starter* - 350 grams bread flour - 2 tbsp granulated sugar - ½ teaspoons dry active yeast
With the machine still running, add the water until a sticky dough has formed. - 180 grams ice water
Let the dough rest, covered in the food processor, for 10 minutes to allow the gluten to rest.
Add olive oil and the salt. Process the dough until completely homogenous. - 1 tbsp (+ more as needed) olive oil - 1 ½ teaspoons kosher salt
On a lightly oiled work surface, shape the dough into a ball. Then, place the dough in an oiled container and cover with a lid or plastic wrap.
Refrigerate for 12-24 hours.
Remove the dough and cut into two even portions.
Shape each portion into a ball and allow to sit, covered, at room temperature for 1-2 hours before baking.
For the White Sauce (Bechamel)
Melt butter in a medium saucepan over medium/high heat. - 2 tbsp butter
Add flour and whisk until no clumps remain. - 2 tbsp flour
Slowly add the milk, only a few tablespoons at a time, and whisk to combine. - 1 cup milk
Cook for an additional 5 minutes, until thickened.
Add white pepper, nutmeg, and salt. - ¾ teaspoon white pepper - ½ teaspoon freshly grated nutmeg - 1 teaspoon kosher salt
Allow to cool and reserve in the refrigerator until ready to use.
For the Garlic Confit

Combine all ingredients in a small saucepan. - whole head of garlic peeled and separated - 1 cup olive oil (enough to cover the garlic) - 1 teaspoon kosher salt - 1 teaspoon freshly ground pepper - 3 dried chilies - 1 bay leaf
Simmer over low heat for 30 minutes.
Allow cooling before removing garlic cloves and reserving the garlic-infused oil.
Store the garlic cloves in an airtight container in the refrigerator until ready to use. The reserved olive oil can be kept at room temperature.
For the Assembly (2 Pizzas):
Place a pizza stone or baking steel on the top rack of the oven. Preheat to 500°F. (Ideally, this should be done 1 hour before baking).
Gently, shape and stretch one dough ball into about a 14 inch round.

For one pizza, brush the crust with olive oil and crushed garlic clove. Add shredded mozzarella and steamed broccoli. - Olive oil - Garlic clove crushed - Low moisture mozzarella cheese shredded - Broccoli florets + stems steamed
Bake directly on the pizza stone for 12-15 minutes, rotating the pizza periodically to achieve even browning.
Remove the pizza from the oven and allow to cool slightly before slicing and serving.
To make second pizza, shape the dough into another 14 inch round.
Brush the crust with the reserved garlic-infused oil and white sauce. - For the White Sauce (Bechamel)
Add the confited garlic cloves, crushing them lightly to reveal the soft interior. - For the Garlic Confit
Top with broccoli rabe and a generous coating of shredded mozzarella and parmesan cheese. - Broccoli rabe sautéed - Low moisture mozzarella cheese shredded - Parmesan cheese grated
Bake directly on the pizza stone for 12-15 minutes, rotating the pizza periodically.
Allow cooling slightly before slicing and serving.
